title: Consciousness is a shared latent space that converts between systems

statements.text: Intelligence is compression and prediction, as in AIXI and FEP-AI, and consciousness may serve it as a lingua franca, a semi-interpretable shared latent space for efficiently converting between heterogeneous systems for the sake of functional synergy.

sources.quote: consciousness may be understood as a kind of lingua franca (or semi-interpretable shared latent space) for more efficiently converting between heterogeneous systems
intelligence is understood in terms of abilities to effectively compress information with algorithms of minimal complexity
